origin.description: Alias of assertSetEqual. Returns the value when it is the same set of values, ignoring order and duplicates. Otherwise it stops with the check message.
origin.usage: assert_set_equal(x, y, ordered = FALSE, fmatch = FALSE, .var.name = vname(x), add = NULL)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Value under test. A Python int is an R integer and a Python float is an R double.

arguments.name: ordered
arguments.text: When true, classes or factor levels must be in this order.

arguments.name: fmatch
arguments.text: Ignored. Matching uses Python's base match.

arguments.name: .var.name
arguments.text: Name used in the assertion message.

arguments.name: add
arguments.text: Collection that stores the message instead of stopping.

origin.details: Alias of assertSetEqual. Returns the value when it is the same set of values, ignoring order and duplicates. Otherwise it stops with the check message.
origin.value: The value when the check passes. Otherwise the check stops.
